title: Kicksite Alternatives: 7 Martial Arts Software Options
description: Kicksite alternatives compared with published prices: Martialytics, Gymdesk, Spark, Zen Planner, PushPress, RhinoFit and Recess for martial arts schools.
h1: Kicksite alternatives for martial arts schools
body:
Kicksite starts at $49/mo for 0-25 students and rises to $99, $149 and $199/mo as you grow (Kicksite pricing). US processing through Basys adds $29/mo plus 2.9% + $0.25 per card. If you are comparing other options, here is what the main alternatives publish.

We checked each vendor's own public pages between October 26 and October 30, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk,spark-membership,pushpress,rhinofit}}

The alternatives

  • Martialytics: $69 (0-50), $99 (51-100), $129 (101-200), $199/mo (200+), every feature on every tier, standard Stripe rates. 30-day trial, no card. Cheaper than Kicksite from 26 to 200 students. See Martialytics vs Kicksite.
  • Gymdesk: $75-$200/mo with Gymdesk Payments ($100-$240 with your own processor) for up to 250 members, month to month, 30-day trial.
  • Spark Membership: $199/mo after an 8-week trial; detailed rank and testing tools; service term set in your order form. See Spark vs Kicksite.
  • Zen Planner: from $99/mo (Studio), $198 with website, $348 with marketing; staff not charged.
  • PushPress: $0/mo Free plan (card 4.99% + $0.30) or $159/mo Pro (card 2.89% + $0.30).
  • RhinoFit: $0 Start Up for 20 or fewer active users, $57/mo Standard with no member limits; belt tracking on all plans.
  • Recess: $0/mo for the school; families pay about 5% at checkout.

Before you switch from Kicksite

Kicksite's terms say annual plans auto-renew every 12 months and aren't refunded if cancelled early, so check your renewal date first. Ask the new vendor whether they import student, rank and billing data, and whether stored cards can be moved. Our software buying checklist covers the rest.

Which to pick

For a lower monthly bill at 26-200 students, Martialytics publishes the lowest tiers here. For deep belt-testing features, Spark. For a very small school, RhinoFit or PushPress Free. {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}} {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}

Related: best martial arts school software · martial arts software pricing by student count · free martial arts software · all martial arts tools
faq: Martialytics lists lower prices from 26 to 200 students ($69 vs $99, $99 vs $149, $129 vs $199). RhinoFit Standard is a flat $57/mo, and PushPress, RhinoFit Start Up and Recess have $0/mo options with trade-offs in fees or limits (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-30).
Can I cancel a Kicksite annual plan early?
Kicksite's terms say annual plans auto-renew every 12 months and are not refunded if cancelled early (kicksite.com/terms).
Does Kicksite have a free trial?
Kicksite says the first 30 days are free (kicksite.com/pricing).
